questions.content: a = 4, b = −2. Find: a) 3a + b  b) a² − 2b  c) 5(a + b)
Write and simplify an expression for the perimeter of a rectangle: length (2x + 1), width (x − 3).
Phone plan costs £(3n + 5)/month (n = GB). a) Cost if n = 4?  b) Sam paid £23 — how many GB?
Prize £P split: Anya £(2x+10), Ben £(x+20), Cara gets rest. a) Expression for Cara. b) x=15, P=100: find each share. c) Fair? Explain.
